data.name: Fasif
data.gender_notes: Fasif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fasaha' which means 'to be quick' or 'to excel'. This name is suitable for a child who is clever and quick to learn. The name Fasif carries the meaning “Quick, clever” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fasif usually hope their child will grow to embody quick, clever and live with faith, good character and purpose.
